The '''2022 Retro League Event 2''' was the second event of the [[2022 Retro League]], won by [[Andy Talaga]]. It was played on [[GEMP]] in [[Premiere - Hoth]] format from early April to mid-May 2022, and 41 players registered.<ref name="t80211" /><ref name="t80048" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' early April – mid-May 2022
* '''Structure:''' six games of Swiss, one game a week, scored by strength of schedule; 45-minute timers per side<ref name="t80048" /><ref name="t80194" />
* '''Players:''' 41
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy Talaga]]
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Sanders]]<ref name="t80296" />
